test_title: PYST 41: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 25 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**throughout**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence discusses indigenous communities in a global context.
 
• The preposition must convey the idea of these communities being spread across all regions of the world.
 
• "**Throughout**" correctly expresses the idea of something occurring in every part of a place or across the entire world.
 
• Other options do not fully convey the global, widespread nature described in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Correct Sentence: *“Indigenous communities **throughout**__ the world are facing some of the most severe climate impacts.”* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Around:** Suggests “near” or “in the surrounding area,” not suitable for a global scale.
 
• **In:** Grammatically correct but not appropriate for describing global distribution.
 
• **Of:** Does not fit the meaning or structure.
